content.short: Berachain is a high-performance EVM-compatible Layer 1 blockchain built on Proof-of-Liquidity.
content.description: Berachain is a high-performance, EVM-compatible Layer 1 blockchain that introduces a novel consensus mechanism known as Proof-of-Liquidity. Designed to align network security with application-level liquidity, the protocol incentivizes users to provide capital to decentralized applications within its ecosystem. Built on the Cosmos SDK, Berachain offers rapid transaction finality, robust security, and deep interoperability across the broader Web3 landscape.
